box.highlights: Half Hollow Hills East 21, Newfield 6: Jordan Heyman threw for 200 yards and three touchdowns and rushed for 50 yards to lead Half Hollow Hills East (1-0) in Suffolk II. Shaki Bethea and Max Kulberg each made seven tackles, and  Anthony Sofia had two sacks and three tackles. Noah Chlap scored a receiving touchdown and had a sack with four tackles. The game was called in the second quarter.

North Babylon 43, Half Hollow Hills East 33: Jawara Keahey ran for 259 yards and three touchdowns on 29 carries to lead North Babylon (2-0) in Suffolk II.  Chris Stumpf connected with Alexander Griffith for an 11-yard touchdown pass to give North Babylon a 37-24 lead in the third quarter. Malyk Montenegro added 65 yards on nine carries, including a 15-yard touchdown. Keahey had a 28-yard touchdown run and rushed in the ensuing two-point conversion to give North Babylon a 28-14 lead in the third quarter. He also ran in a 5-yard touchdown to give North Babylon a 43-24 lead in the fourth quarter. Jordan Heyman had two passing and a rushing touchdown for Half Hollow Hills East (1-1).

Half Hollow Hills East 49, Centereach 13: Jordan Heyman threw for 329 yards and five touchdowns to lead Half Hollow Hills East in Suffolk II. Lucas Martin had 100 receiving yards and two touchdowns and Daniel White ran for 115 yards and a touchdown and had 60 receiving yards and a touchdown. Shakie Bethea ran for 97 yards and a touchdown and had an interception and seven tackles on defense. Max Futter caught a 40-yard touchdown, threw a two-point conversion and made five PATs. Max Kulberg had 10 tackles, two forced fumbles and a fumble recovery for Half Hollow Hills East (2-1). Anthony Prince and Manny Menendez each had rushing touchdowns for Centereach (1-2).

Half Hollow Hills East 38, Bellport 6: Jordan Heyman threw for 301 yards and five scores of 36, 42, 17, 41, and 29 yards to lead Hills East (3-1) in Suffolk II. Daniel White rushed for 102 yards on 27 carries and Max Futter had three receptions for 63 yards and a touchdown and added 5 PATs. Kingston John had an interception and an 8-yard touchdown run for Bellport (2-2).

Half Hollow Hills East 27, Deer Park 24: Daniel White rushed for 260 yards and  three rushing touchdowns to lead Half Hollow Hills East (4-1) in Suffolk II. Shakie Bethea added a 25-yard rushing touchdown and 13 tackles on defense. Tyler Sanders had two interceptions and Half Hollow Hills forced five Deer Park turnovers. Huntley Swaby, Hunter and Hayden Lovinsky scored touchdowns for Deer Park (4-1).

Half Hollow Hills East 44, West Islip 43: Half Hollow Hills East scored with 21 seconds left to tie the score at 43. Max Futter kicked the extra point to give Hills East (5-1) the win over previously unbeaten West Islip (5-1).

Half Hollow Hills East 55, Huntington 21: Jordan Heyman threw for 200 yards and six touchdowns and added 50 rushing yards to lead Half Hollow Hills East (6-1) in Suffolk II. Shakie Bethea returned a kickoff 98 yards for a touchdown, had nine tackles, an interception and a fumble recovery. Max Futter had 120 receiving yards and two touchdowns, and Daniel White rushed for 230 yards and scored two touchdowns. Max Kulberg had nine tackles, one sack and forced two fumbles, and Anthony Sofia had three tackles and a sack. Huntington is 1-6.

Half Hollow Hills East 63, Northport 41: Jordan Heyman threw for 475 yards and eight touchdowns to lead host Half Hollow Hills East (7-1) in Suffolk II. Lucas Martin had 170 yards receiving, three receiving touchdowns and an 80-yard kick return touchdown. Daniel White had 150 yards receiving and a touchdown. Tyler Sanders had 165 receiving yards and three touchdowns and caught an interception. Max Futter had 109 receiving yards, a touchdown, a forced fumble and fumble recovery. Noah Chlapp made 13 tackles, had a sack and an interception. Anthony Sofia made eight tackles. Michael Campoli scored three rushing touchdowns and caught two touchdowns for Northport (4-4).

Half Hollow Hills East 35, Bellport 7: Daniel White ran for 200 yards and touchdowns of 4, 14 and 63 yards to lead host No. 3 Half Hollow Hills East over No. 6 Bellport in the Suffolk II quarterfinals. Jordan Heyman threw for 233 yards and a 27-yard touchdown to Lucas Martin and added a 24-yard rushing score. Noah Chlap had 18 tackles and Shakie Bethea had 10 tackles and an interception. Akio Johnson had 10 tackles and Elias Floropoulos had five tackles and two sacks. Brayden Cipp scored a 9-yard rushing touchdown for Bellport, which finished 4-5. Half Hollow Hills East (8-1) will visit No. 2 West Islip in the semifinals on Friday.

West Islip 31, Half Hollow Hills East 26: Rocco Carpinello rushed for 210 yards and three touchdowns on 23 carries, including the go-ahead score with 11 seconds remaining to lead West Islip in the Suffolk II semifinals. Chris Piropato added 85 yards rushing and a touchdown on 16 carries. Jovan Brewster made eight tackles and had an interception with 2:25 left to get the Lions the ball for their final drive. Piropato led the team with 11 tackles.
